stem: Which of these does NOT represent the distance a car travels when going 55 miles per hour?

options.label: A
options.text: d = 55t, where d represents distance in miles and t represents time in hours

options.label: C
options.text: In 3 hours a car will travel a distance of 160 miles.

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph showing a line from (0,0) to about (4,220) labeled with axes Time (hours) and Distance (miles))

graph labeled Car Travel with x-axis Time (hours) and y-axis Distance (miles) with a diagonal line
